editorial.title: A room is finished when you stop noticing it.
editorial.body1: We are not interested in rooms that photograph well and live badly. The good ones are quieter than that. A lamp at the right height, wool that holds its shape, a bowl that gets used on a Tuesday.
editorial.body2: So we choose slowly. Every piece has to answer the same questions before it goes on the site, and anything that feels thin or loud does not make it.

about.title: About
about.metaDescription: Haven Huis is a small home decor shop run from Rotterdam, selling lighting, textiles and ceramics chosen for the way they age.
about.lead: Haven means refuge. Huis means house. We sell the things that turn one into the other.
about.body1: Haven Huis started in a flat in Rotterdam with a problem most people recognise: everything on offer was either disposable or unaffordable, and very little of it was interesting. So we started choosing pieces ourselves, one at a time, against a single question. Would we live with this?
about.body2: We keep the range small on purpose. Twelve pieces means every one of them was argued over. We look at the material first, then the proportion, then how a piece will sit next to the things you already own. Anything that photographs well and lives badly is left out.
about.body3: Nothing here is warehoused. Each piece is sourced and shipped on its own once you order it, which takes fifteen to thirty business days. That is slower than a shelf two hours away, and it is the reason the price is what it is. If a piece is not right, thirty days and a prepaid label will sort it out.
about.imageAlt: Neutral living room with layered textiles and woven baskets

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.body: Your order goes to its maker the day it is placed. You'll get a tracking link as soon as the parcel is scanned, and a separate one for each piece in a multi-item order.

rows.elsewhereValue: Not shipping yet, write to us

delivery.title: Why it takes the time it does
delivery.body: We hold no stock. Each piece is picked for your order and travels on its own, which is why an order of three items can arrive as three parcels on three different days. Everything is tracked from the first scan.

returns.title: Returns
returns.body: Thirty days from delivery, for any reason. The piece needs to come back in a condition you would be happy to receive it in. The original packaging helps but is not required.

steps.one: Email hello@havenhuis.nl with your order number.
steps.two: We send a prepaid label within one working day.
steps.three: Drop the parcel at any pickup point.
steps.four: Refund lands 3–5 business days after the parcel reaches us.

returns.note: Made-to-order and sale pieces are covered too. Only candles that have been burned are excluded, for the obvious reason.

payment.title: Payment
payment.body: Payment runs through Stripe's secure checkout, and the whole bag is paid for in one go. Cards and Apple Pay are accepted today; iDEAL and the other Dutch methods follow.

form.success: Your cancellation is logged. We confirm it by email within one working day, and anything already paid is refunded within 14 days.

rights.title: Your right to cancel
rights.body: You have 14 days from the day the last piece in your order reaches you to withdraw from the purchase. You do not have to give a reason, and using the right costs you nothing. It is a statutory right under EU consumer law, not something this shop grants you.
rights.policy: Haven Huis gives you 30 days rather than 14, so the shop policy is the more generous of the two and applies on top of the statutory right. Whichever you use, you are never worse off than the law leaves you.
rights.refund: We refund everything you paid, standard delivery included, within 14 days of the cancellation. If a parcel has already reached you, send it back first — the return label is on us.
